points.quote: Declare an interface and give it a brand: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService');`. ... The interface and the const share one name. The const is both the service identifier and a parameter decorator.
Constructors declare dependencies with `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService`.

`createInstance(Ctor, ...staticArgs)` builds an object and resolves the decorated params from its `ServiceCollection`. ... Contributions ... are created with `instantiationService.createInstance`, so they get injection too.
`registerSingleton(IFooService, FooService, InstantiationType.Delayed | Eager)` in `extensions.ts` registers it.
